kitDescription: Trina (RL / Electric / Supporter / Burst II, cd 20s) — a pure Electric-AR support enabler. Her damage-relevant output is: S2 start-of-battle Max HP grant + burst-cast Attack Damage ▲94.15% / Reload Speed ▲50.82% to the leftmost Electric-AR ally; burst all-ally Attack Damage ▲20.9% (+caster-keyed Max HP); burst Hit Rate ▲45.3% + Max Ammo ▲20 rounds to Electric-AR allies. Her own RL damage is negligible. Non-damage / unmodelable-in-v1 kit: three S1 heals, S2 Invulnerable, and the Spread/Wilted Roots AoE-burst-damage amp.

s2b_fable_preop.result: FULL spec convergence on every load-bearing line. Independently derived maxAmmoFlat 20 (nearest-wrong 'maxAmmoPct … differ wildly'), corroborating the driver's S3 fix. Two dispositions differ (S1 HoT: fable FAITHFUL-as-recovery-emitter, Hit Rate: fable FAITHFUL-with-⚑) — both reconcile to documented engine/measurement gaps, not divergences against the driver.

s5_blind_tests.specConvergence: FULL — the blind per-line spec agrees with the driver on every load-bearing line (burst 20.9 all-allies FAITHFUL, S2 94.15/50.82 Electric-AR count:1 burstCast FAITHFUL, maxAmmoFlat 20 independently derived, S1 heals + invuln + Spread/Wilted Roots GAP, hitRate 45.3 ⚑).
s5_blind_tests.testRun: 3 passed / 2 failed / 6 skipped (11). The 2 failures are BLIND HARNESS ARTIFACTS, not override divergences: (b) goPatched discards withPatchedOverride's returned clone so the counterfactual is never applied; (c) num(totals(res)) misreads the harness Record<slug,number> so base.tot is always 0 — both counterfactual assertions compare 0>0. Driver's own T5 verifies both faithfully. RED-only-from-artifacts, classified.

s6_blind_override.result: Structurally IDENTICAL to the driver on every load-bearing block (S2 burstCast Electric-AR count:1 94.15+50.82, burst all-allies 20.9, burst Electric-AR maxAmmoFlat 20 — a THIRD independent derivation of the fix, Spread/Wilted Roots UNMODELED). Three divergences, ALL adjudicated as the driver being MORE faithful: (1) casterMaxHpPct (driver, kit says 'of the skill USER'S Max HP') vs targetMaxHpPct (blind, self-flagged the mismatch); (2) S1 HoT UNMODELED (driver — no heal primitive in v1) vs blind heal-block (would not validate/execute); (3) Hit Rate UNMODELED measurement-gated (driver, project decision) vs blind hitRatePct-with-⚑. None a real gotcha against the driver.

convergence.overall: CONVERGENT — cross-family agreement across three independent blind re-derivations on every load-bearing structural decision; the maxAmmoFlat 20 fix is corroborated ×3 (fable S2b, opus S5, opus S6); all divergences resolve toward the driver.

verdictRationale: GO. Every kit line is accounted for: 4 FAITHFUL (S2 casterMaxHpPct 44.98, S2 burstCast 94.15/50.82, burst all-ally 20.9/20.14, burst maxAmmoFlat 20) and 7 documented UNMODELED/GAP/⚑ (3 S1 heals, S2 invuln, Spread/Wilted Roots, Hit Rate) — audit SKIPPED ↔ unmodeled 1:1, no silent drops. No REAL-GOTCHA: the three S6 blind divergences all resolve toward the driver being MORE faithful (casterMaxHpPct over targetMaxHpPct per kit prose; S1 HoT UNMODELED because no heal primitive exists; Hit Rate UNMODELED per the project's measurement-gated decision). The S5 blind tests converge FULLY on spec; their 2 test failures are classified blind harness artifacts (unapplied counterfactual + a Record-shape misread), RED only from blindness, not override divergence. The maxAmmoFlat 20 fix is cross-family corroborated ×3 and regression-neutral. Discrimination passes (§8 matrix, no vacuous tests), the fire-rate check passes (FAITHFUL blocks fire every cycle), and every ⚑ carries estimate + recipe + tier. Residual owner spot-check items (S1 heal/recovery primitive gap + burst Hit Rate 45.3 measurement-gated ⚑) are documented engine/measurement gaps, not blockers. Verdict is BINDING.
